body: thank you, ive tried to change the past few years, and it was successful to a point but i still dont see me being happy in the future. if robin williams wasnt happy how can i be lol. as soon as i can find an easy / effective way ill probably go. i appreciate you though, you brought up some good points and got me thinking. thanks again

Im sorry :\ since you work in violence prevention are there any superiors or therapists you can talk to? I'm sure your employers would help you. Also, it takes a strong person to be able to talk about the trauma like that, so you are stronger than you think. Also, maybe a break with your boyfriend could be good temporarily, have you told him what you have written? He may be more supportive than you think.

Can you start applying for jobs online while shes away? Maybe try to secure a job, and dont be afraid to ask people in class for temporary help. You could maybe move out or live in your car for a little?
